newsitem.title: USA: Two women feared abducted in Tennessee robbery.
newsitem.headline: Two women feared abducted in Tennessee robbery.

text.p: Two young women were apparently abucted during a robbery at an ice cream store where they worked, police said Thursday.
In an all-night search, police failed to find a trace of the 21-year-old store manager and her 16-year-old employee, police officer Bob Davis told Reuters.

The store in this town 50 miles northwest of Nashville, was robbed late Wednesday night. A brother of one of the women found the door unlocked and the safe opened when he went to the shop at closing time. The women's purses were left behind.
"We have saturated the area looking for these people," Davis said. He said a surveillance tape from a camera inside the store had been removed for study and the FBI had been asked for help.
